crmContacts.name: Ognjen Dedagić / UWC Adriatic
crmContacts.title: University Counselor
crmContacts.lastEmailReceived: Dear Linnea, although we generally welcome all visits from universities we do have a policy and a recommended timing for the visits. The days you suggested are really not ideal as the IBDP1 students still have to have the first big university applications meeting on the 14th of April and we usually do not host university talks before that event. Obviously, the Fall is the best moment to reach out to students (we have 40-50 institutions visiting each Fall). I understand that you might be in the area now so the only thing that could be arranged is a more informal chat on Wednesday the 9th in the afternoon. I can advertise that you will be visiting and potentially interested student (who do not have CAS commitments) could come... Let me know, - Suggested potential visit dates: Sep 25, Oct 7, Oct 10, Nov 5, and Nov 7.
crmContacts.notes: Suggested potential visit dates: Sep 25, Oct 7, Oct 10, Nov 5, and Nov 7. - get back to him with my planned dates.
